title: Proteomic analysis of CSF samples from patients across the Alsheimer's disease continuum
projectDescription: Proteomic analysis of CSF from patients in different stages of developinf Alzheimer's disease, and healthy control individuals (n=229).
sampleProcessingProtocol: Proteins in CSF samples were subjected to reduction of disulfides, carbamidomethylation of free Cys residues, and trypsin digestion. The tryptic peptides were labeled using TMT 16-plex reagents. Multiplexed TMT samples were deslated by SPE (SepPak C18) and fractionated using high-pH reversed-phase HPLC into 24 concatenated fractions. The fractions were analysed by nano-flow LC-MS coupled to an Orbitrap hybrid mass spectrometer (Lumos, Thermo Scientific).
dataProcessingProtocol: LC-MS Data were processed using Proteome Discoverer 2.5.
